body:
Held, from the epic PM for #12243 — and this one needs a decision before it is dispatched to anyone.

`content/docs/releases/**` is under a hard stop in CLAUDE.md: release notes are written centrally at release time and ⛔ never edited in a code PR, because per-PR edits made that directory the repo's hottest conflict magnet. The rule's own escape hatch is a **dedicated docs-only PR**, which this could legitimately be — but 3 of the 4 pages use `# ` as real top-level dividers owning `##` children, so the fix is a cascading demotion that restructures a release-notes document, not a formatting tidy.

That is an editorial call on release-owned files, so it waits for the maintainer rather than being dispatched on the epic PM's judgement. `implementation-status.mdx` is the ordinary mechanical case and could be split out if the other three stay parked.

## Selection note — the two comments above conflict, and the conflict is resolved. ⛔ Do not re-litigate it next round.

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`, R34, at card selection.
⛔ Not a dispatch — this card is next in line, and this note exists so the next reader does not spend
the selection budget re-deriving what follows.

**The epic PM (2026-08-25 15:27Z)** held the card: *"That is an editorial call on release-owned
files, so it waits for the maintainer rather than being dispatched on the epic PM's judgement."*

**Triage (2026-08-25 15:55Z, 28 minutes later)** answered exactly that point: *"The direction is
settled enough not to need a ruling; if the dev finds a page whose hierarchy cannot cascade cleanly,
report the fork."*

⇒ The later comment is by **the seat that produces state on this board**, it names **both** of the
epic PM's constraints (the `CLAUDE.md` hard stop; the cascading demotion) rather than talking past
them, and the label it left is **`pm:queue`** with no `needs-user-decision` and no `pm:retriage`.
⭐ **The label is the state machine.** A hold that its own producer has since answered is not a hold.

### What the resolution does NOT license

⛔ The `CLAUDE.md` hard stop still binds: this ships as a **dedicated docs-only PR** with no riders,
which is that rule's own escape hatch — ⛔ not an exception to it.
⛔ The escape hatch triage attached is real and load-bearing: **a page whose hierarchy cannot cascade
cleanly is a fork to report, ⛔ not a judgement call to make.** The editorial risk the epic PM named
is handled by that, not dismissed by it.

### Two facts re-derived for the next dispatcher, so they are not re-derived twice

- **The gate carve-out is no longer contended.** #12236 — the sub-issue that created
  `scripts/check-docs-single-h1.mjs` and carved out `content/docs/releases/**` — is **closed**. Epic
  #12243's remaining open sub-issues are #12237 and #12238, both frontmatter copy rewrites that
  touch no gate. ⇒ The card's third acceptance box (delete the carve-out) is free to execute.
- **The serialisation behind #12507 has expired** — #12507 closed at 08:38Z this round.

⇒ **Dispatchable, on the next free slot.** Concurrency is 4 and currently full (#13582, #13653,
#12353, #11887).

## Claim + Dispatch — R34

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`. Branch: **`claude/issue-12250-releases-h1-cascade`**

**The epic-PM hold vs. triage conflict is resolved** — see this seat's selection note two comments up.
⛔ Do not re-open it. Short form: triage answered the hold 28 minutes later, by name, and left
`pm:queue`; the label is the state machine. **The escape hatch it attached is real and binding — a
page whose hierarchy cannot cascade cleanly is a fork to REPORT, ⛔ not a judgement call to make.**

**Serialisation**: ⛔ no hold on `content/docs/releases/**` or `scripts/check-docs-single-h1.mjs`.
#12507 (the card that held this one) closed at 08:38Z. Epic #12243's `content/docs/**` slice is
frontmatter and body headings — ⚠️ **your change IS headings**, but on the one subtree that epic
explicitly carved OUT of #12236, and #12236 is **closed**. Its remaining open sub-issues (#12237,
#12238) rewrite frontmatter copy and touch no gate. ⇒ Clear, and say so in the PR body.

### Zone 1 — TRIAGE RULING (⛔ 不可重裁,verbatim)

> Two constraints ride the card, both from standing rules rather than new judgement: (1)
> `content/docs/releases/` is under the CLAUDE.md hard stop for code PRs — **this fix must ship as a
> dedicated docs-only PR, no riders**; (2) the three `v*.mdx` fixes are **cascading demotions** —
> every descendant heading moves down one level so "in detail" sections keep owning their
> subsections (the card's second acceptance box), **not a mechanical `#`→`##`**.
> `implementation-status.mdx` is the one mechanical deletion. The direction is settled enough not to
> need a ruling; **if the dev finds a page whose hierarchy cannot cascade cleanly, report the fork.**

⛔ **No riders means no riders.** Nothing but this fix goes in this PR — not a typo you notice in
passing, not a neighbouring heading, nothing. The whole reason this directory has a hard stop is
that per-PR edits made it the repo's worst conflict magnet.

### Zone 2 — PM 机制假设(⚠️ 须实测。⭐ I re-measured two of these for you; ⛔ neither is a ruling)

- **A2.1 — ⭐ the card's census still holds EXACTLY, six days on.** Re-derived on `origin/main` just
  now, counting `# ` at body level only (frontmatter skipped):
  ```
  implementation-status.mdx : 6
  v15.mdx                   : 66, 342
  v16.mdx                   : 117, 860
  v17.mdx                   : 209, 3382
  ```
  Identical to the card's measurement at `20b0fdb56` — same lines, same pages, 7 body H1s across 4
  files. ⇒ ⛔ Do not spend a cycle re-censusing the whole tree; do confirm these 7 before you cut.
- **A2.2 — ⚠️ THE CARVE-OUT IS NOT ONE LINE, AND ITS SELF-TEST WILL FIGHT YOU.** The third acceptance
  box says delete the `content/docs/releases/**` carve-out from `scripts/check-docs-single-h1.mjs`.
  The `prefix: 'content/docs/releases/'` entry is at ~line 172, **but the suite around lines 380-425
  is built on it**: it writes a fixture `content/docs/releases/v9.mdx`, asserts *"...but its
  violations are still counted"*, then removes the fixture and asserts *"a CLEAN excluded subtree
  reports zero — the dead-exclusion trigger"*. ⇒ Deleting the prefix without reworking those cases
  either breaks the suite or leaves it testing a carve-out that no longer exists. ⛔ Do not delete
  the cases — decide what each one should assert once the subtree is in scope, and say so.
- **A2.3 — the dead-exclusion trigger is the card's own safety net, ⛔ don't defeat it.** That gate
  **fails when an excluded tree becomes clean**, which is why the card calls box 3 "mechanical, not a
  thing to remember". ⇒ If you clean the pages and leave the carve-out, CI tells you. ⭐ Sequence your
  commits so you can *see* that happen at least once — it is free evidence that the trigger works.
- **A2.4 — I assume all four pages are hand-authored.** ⚠️ Verify by the **banner in the file head**,
  ⛔ not a whole-file grep — that instrument gave this seat a false positive earlier today on two
  pages whose bodies merely contain the words "auto-generated". A generated page would change the
  whole shape of this card.
- **A2.5 — I assume the cascade is uniform per page, ⛔ and I have not checked it.** The card shows
  `# X in detail` owning `##` children with `## Highlights` as a *sibling* above it. ⚠️ If any page
  mixes depths — an `H3` that belongs to the pre-`#` material, an `H2` that is really a peer of the
  `#` — a blanket "every descendant down one" is wrong there. **That is the fork triage told you to
  report**, and reporting it beats guessing.

### Zone 3 — 建议路线(可选,⛔ 不是指令)

`v17.mdx` has ~3400 lines and its second H1 is at 3382, so its cascade is nearly the whole file; the
other two are smaller. Doing `implementation-status.mdx` (the single line deletion) and one `v*.mdx`
first gives you a shape to check before committing to the other two.

### Standing constraints

⛔ Worktree-first before your first edit. ⛔ Never `git stash`. ⚠️ **`content/docs/releases/` is under
the `CLAUDE.md` hard stop — this PR is that rule's own escape hatch (a dedicated docs-only PR) and
⛔ nothing else may ride in it.** ⛔ Governed surface (`docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`,
`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`) — stop and report. ⛔ No `packages/spec/src/**`. Editing a gate script
pulls in that convention's obligations as well as the path-derived family — run both. Report gates
as GREEN / RED / NOT MEASURED with the exit code you actually saw before any pipe, and declare any
narrowing with a measurement rather than an assertion.

## ACCEPT — PR #13754

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`. R34.

### The cascade is count-preserving on every page — measured, not eyeballed

I counted ATX headings by level on `origin/main` and at the PR head `939f51465`, skipping
frontmatter and fenced blocks:

| page | main | PR head | total |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `implementation-status.mdx` | `{1:1, 2:14, 3:23}` | `{2:14, 3:23}` | 38 → 37, ⭐ **only the duplicate title is gone; nothing else moved** |
| `v15.mdx` | `{1:2, 2:14, 3:40}` | `{2:4, 3:12, 4:40}` | **56 → 56** |
| `v16.mdx` | `{1:2, 2:13, 3:32}` | `{2:4, 3:11, 4:32}` | **47 → 47** |
| `v17.mdx` | `{1:2, 2:18, 3:88}` | `{2:5, 3:15, 4:88}` | **108 → 108** |

⭐ Every heading is accounted for: zero body H1 left, levels 2/3/4 with **no skipped level**, and the
surviving level-2 count on each page is exactly *(the 2 demoted H1s) + (the leading `## Highlights`
blocks)* — 2+2, 2+2, 2+3. That is the claim "the Highlights blocks are not descendants and stay put",
**arithmetically**, ⛔ not by assertion. A2.1's census also re-confirms at the same seven lines
(6 · 66,342 · 117,860 · 209,3382).

### ⭐ The dead-exclusion trigger was WATCHED FIRING

With the content fixed and the carve-out still in place, the gate exited 1 with its own words:

> `DEAD-EXCLUSION: content/docs/releases/** is clean, so its EXCLUSIONS entry checks nothing. #12250 appears to have landed.`

⛔ Free evidence, taken **before** touching the gate, that the limb the card leans on actually works.
`EXCLUSIONS` is now `[]` and the corpus is judged at **404 pages, 0 subtrees excluded** — and the
docblock rewrite records that the limb has now paid out **twice** (`references/**` via #12249,
`releases/**` here), which is the whole of the evidence that it works. ⭐ With the list empty the live
corpus exercises none of that machinery, so `scanTree` takes exclusions as a **parameter** and the
self-test drives a **synthetic** one — the same "prove genericity without filling the table" move
#13582 made this morning. Consistency across two independent cards on the same day.

### A2.5 measured, and the answer was "no fork" — with a boundary held

All three `v*.mdx` have the identical shape, so the blanket cascade is right on each and preserves
the tree isomorphically. ⭐ And the thing the dev did **not** do is the better half: on all three
pages `Upgrade checklist` and `References` sit under the last H1 while covering **both** releases.
The cascade preserves that pre-existing relationship rather than re-parenting them — **re-parenting
is an editorial change and would have been a rider**, on the one directory in this repo where riders
are banned by name. ⛔ Correctly left alone and reported instead.

### A2.4 — my instrument warning was not theoretical

`implementation-status.mdx` really does say *"This matrix is generated from actual codebase
analysis"* in body prose inside a Callout. ⇒ The whole-file grep I warned about **would have flagged
it as generated and excluded it**, losing the one mechanical fix on the card. The file-head banner
instrument reads all four correctly as hand-authored. ⭐ Third confirmation today that the loose
instrument fails toward wrongly excluding real work.

### Gates

**33/38 GREEN**, family re-derived **after** the final commit (5 paths → 38 families = 36
path-derived + 2 convention-triggered by the gate-script edit), commands harvested with
`--commands` so neither invocation spelling was dropped, exit codes captured by redirect-then-capture
and ⛔ never through a pipe. Includes `check:docs-single-h1` (*"20 cases pass"*, *"404 page(s) …
carry no body-level # heading (0 subtree(s) excluded)"*), both convention obligations, and the four
release-specific guards. `pnpm lint` repo-wide `EXIT=0` ⇒ ⛔ no eslint narrowing owed.

**5 NOT MEASURED, none a finding, each self-declared** — and ⭐ **the narrowing is declared with a
measurement**: all four unbuilt-package gates read either the generated reference tree or fenced code
blocks, and this diff reaches neither. `content/docs/references/**` files changed = **0**; `os:check`
markers in the four changed pages = **0,0,0,0**; and the **sha256 over each page's concatenated
fenced-block bodies is IDENTICAL** at base and at head. Independently, filtering the diff to changed
lines that are not ATX headings leaves **only the single blank line** beside the deleted title.

⭐ **No changeset, and no `skip-changeset` label needed** — I checked rather than assuming, because
every other PR this round carried that label: `Check Changeset` reports **success** on this head with
no label at all. ⛔ I did not add one the repo did not ask for.

### Ablation

Two legs on the reworked self-test, both mutating the **committed** implementation and confirmed on
disk before any reading (grep counts for injected *and* removed text, plus `git hash-object` differing
from the HEAD blob): (A) `exclusionFor` ignores its parameter ⇒ `EXIT=1`, 3 of 20 fail; (B) drop the
`continue` so excluded pages are judged ⇒ `EXIT=1`, 3 of 20 fail. Restores proven by **observed
state** — blob back to `5c2f1510…`, equal to HEAD's and non-empty, `git status --porcelain` empty,
self-test back to 20/20. ⭐ And the honest negative stated up front: **no rebuild leg exists** (a plain
`.mjs` node runs from source, no dist, no vitest alias) — ⛔ so none was faked.

### Out of scope, filed not fixed — correctly

**#13757**: `check-release-section-coverage.mjs`'s `REAL_V17_HEADINGS` fixture is commented *"kept
verbatim so the matcher is judged against text that actually shipped"* but holds `# 17.0.0 in
detail`, which this PR cascades to `##`. The gate stays **green** (its matcher is level-agnostic
`^#{1,6}` and nothing compares the fixture to the live page — measured, exit 0 on the cascaded tree),
so it is comment/fixture drift, ⛔ not a defect this PR introduced. Filed `finding`/`tooling`/
`domain:devx`, unassigned, ⛔ no `pm:queue` — ⭐ exactly right: a second gate-script edit here would
have been the rider the no-riders constraint forbids.

### Disposition

⛔ Not governed surface (`content/docs/releases/**` + one `scripts/**` file); `Governed Surface Queue
Guard` already **success** on the draft. No clause ② limb. **Arming once `Lint & Repo Gates`
settles green**; `Fixes #12250` closes this card on merge.
